record: Hiller Aviation Museum about page and address
facts: The museum opened in 1998 and lists the San Carlos Airport site at 601 Skyway Road.
The principal gallery has 27,600 square feet of floor area and the atrium has 8,640 square feet. The simulator room at the far end faces the airport.
The collection lists a Rutan Long EZ homebuilt aircraft. The cleared exterior photograph identifies the roof exhibit as a Long-EZ.
